readme_features: Full rule handling: castling, en passant, promotions, checkmate/stalemate detection, repetition detection, and the 50-move rule inside search.
UCI support for the common engine loop: `uci`, `isready`, `ucinewgame`, `position startpos|fen`, `go depth`, `go movetime`, and clock-driven `go`.
CLI perft modes for correctness testing:
Root search info output in UCI format.
Deterministic opening suites in [`openings/book.pgn`](openings/book.pgn) and [`openings/book.epd`](openings/book.epd) for tournament runs.

prompt_subtasks.item: PASS 1 (Extraction): reconstruct the feature backlog + prompt ledger + replay package (repro-first, factual).
PASS 2 (Interpretation): characterize agent strategies, outcomes/quality, interaction demand; correlate with lightweight repo metrics.
I will NOT provide transcripts proactively.
You must analyze the repo as-is (git history may be minimal/absent).
Codex stores local state under CODEX_HOME (default ~/.codex). Session artifacts are typically under:
$CODEX_HOME/log/ (diagnostic logs; location may vary via config)
Prefer transcript evidence from these artifacts; fall back to repo-only when unavailable.
Do NOT invent features, decisions, commands, or outcomes.
Every claim must be traceable to evidence from: repo files, git commits (if any), CODEX_HOME session artifacts, and run/test logs you executed.
If you infer anything, label it INFERRED and justify why.
Redact secrets (tokens/keys) if encountered in repo or logs.
Keep quotes short (<= 25 words). Prefer pointers.
[R:path:lines] repo file references (include line ranges when possible)
[L:run_<n>] outputs of build/test/run commands you executed
Do NOT list them in the FEATURE BACKLOG table.
If explicitly requested by the user for reproducibility, put them in a separate section:
repo root, primary language(s), entry points, build system, test framework, CI configs.
git metadata if present: branch, HEAD, remotes.
Identify project rules that may affect behavior: AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING, .codex/config.toml, etc.
Determine CODEX_HOME (env var if set; else ~/.codex).
Search for session files likely tied to this repo by:
`cobochess --perft "<FEN>" <depth>` → prints `nodes=<N>` and exits non-zero on parse error.
`uci` → prints `id name`, `id author`, `option name Hash type spin default 16 min 1 max 1024`, then `uciok`
`ucinewgame` → clears internal search state (history, TT if any)
`go movetime M` (M in ms; internally use centiseconds = `M/10` rounded)
`go wtime <ms> btime <ms> winc <ms> binc <ms> movestogo <n>` (simple allocation rule)
`stop` (best-effort: stop after current iteration / node batch; must respond promptly)
Always output `bestmove <move>` (UCI coordinate, promotion suffix `q/r/b/n`), or `bestmove 0000` if no legal move.
Periodic `info` lines during search (at least at end of each completed depth): `info depth D nodes N score cp S pv ...`
White: `WP=1 WN=2 WB=3 WR=4 WQ=5 WK=6`
Black: `BP=7 BN=8 BB=9 BR=10 BQ=11 BK=12`
`HISTORY-KEYS[]` (for repetition; store Zobrist key per ply)
